queries: WITH staff_totals AS (SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id) SELECT staff_id, total_amount, total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM staff_totals ORDER BY staff_id
